visual_argument: At the distance a car window camera works from, the two labels the release names are one kind of animal a few postures apart, a lean dog with its head low and tail tucked beside a fuller dog with its head up, each boxed in gold, so the reader sees that the call is made by appearance.
build_risk: The kit has no dog. The chassis builds street_dog as one signed distance body meshed by K.sdfMesh with angulated hocks, fur normals and sheen; a tube built prototype read as a toy at 3 m, the SDF build read as a lean street dog at 5 m. Two dogs at about a fifth of the frame height must read as fur and anatomy and differ in build and pose without caricature. Fallback after one failed repair: move both to 8 m and let rim light and posture carry the two states.
distinct_from_recent: No. 65 was a lastLight foundry interior with a primitive robot arm; this is an exterior residential street with an animal, a car and a phone, and one dark room. No. 64 was road paint at dusk, a surface study in plan; here asphalt is only ground and the reliefs are caliche on black clay. No. 63 was a brass balance in a case on a dais; there is no dais, case, brass or round object here.
